The '''Lone Scout A-2''' or '''LSA-2''' was a variant of the [[Lone Scout-A]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]].

==Characteristics==
The Lone Scout A-2 shared a similar design with the Lone Scout-A, but incorporated an improved [[backup hyperdrive]] and an improved deep scan [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array.<ref name="GG8" /> However, these improvements reduced the LSA-2 cargo capacity by twenty-five [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]<ref name="UA" />

==Role==
The Lone Scout A-2 was used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]],<ref name="UA" /> the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]], and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]]<ref name="GG8" />

==History==
Lone Scout A-2s were dispatched by the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to investigate [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] claims that the main [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="UA">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref> The popularity of the Lone Scout A-2 brought it into service with the New Republic's Scout Service. The New Republic used the Lone Scout A-2 for standard exploration missions into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The vessels were usually crewed by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and specialist, but the extra space allowed the ship to perform a variety of missions.<ref name="GG8" />
